verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's own marketing claims "customizable automation" for alert disposition and screening, and says it "automates routine work" and moves cases between agents and the team (docs-22, docs-23). The docs show some fixed event-driven behaviors: auto-scheduled pending reviews, alerts auto-grouped into cases, and auto-adding the Financial Institution as a configuration setting. However, workflow configuration is described as something Hummingbird sets up for the customer ("We can easily configure your Hummingbird account"), not a user-authored rule engine. Missing for 10: a documented user-facing rule builder for event triggers and conditions, a catalog of available trigger events and actions, AI-native or programmatic rule definition, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
